{{Top}}
A '''philosopher''' was an individual who studied '''philosophy'''. [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the reign of [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], was a philosopher.

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[Bucrkam Inney]] was a [[quartz philosopher]].<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
